Confirmed 50-amp full hookups, laundry. Added Campspot booking, max rig 80 ft. Note cleaned of the rate line. Price gate passes either way (under US$50 on Campspot; $45 posted).
flags: Rig-age rule: 'We accept units that are older than 10 years old provided photos are provided via email. Once approved your reservation will be accepted.' (policies page). AWH's long-stay test 2 names 'photos of the rig' as a barrier; this park is not mainly long-stay, but a human may want to judge it.

Booking engine and posted rates disagree: Campspot sells electric-only $25 and full-hookup $35 for Nov 2026 nights, while the policies page lists $45/$55/$65. Possibly soft-opening pricing; re-check later.
